strings.zh: 哎呀,路过的训练家！{NEWLINE}这边这边,请到这边来！
strings.en: Oh! You there, the Trainer passing by!{NEWLINE}Over here, over here! This way, please!

strings.zh: 你好,我是在吉野商店打工的水晶。{SCROLL}水晶『一看你就是外地来的训练家,{NEWLINE}欢迎来到吉野市！{CLEAR}下面由我带你参观一下吉野市吧。
strings.en: Hello! I’m Crystal. I work{NEWLINE}part-time at the Cherrygrove Mart.{SCROLL}Crystal: I can tell you’re{NEWLINE}a Trainer from out of town.{CLEAR}Welcome to Cherrygrove City!{CLEAR}Let me show you around.

strings.zh: 水晶『这里是精灵中心！{NEWLINE}把受伤的精灵带来{CLEAR}一下子就能治好了！{SCROLL}水晶『不过这种常识性的事情,{NEWLINE}你这位看起来很老道的训练家{CLEAR}应该早就知道了吧。
strings.en: Crystal: This is the Pokémon Center!{NEWLINE}Bring your hurt Pokémon here,{CLEAR}and they’ll be healed in no time!{SCROLL}Crystal: But an experienced Trainer{NEWLINE}like you must know that already.

strings.zh: 水晶『这里是友好商店,{NEWLINE}会有各式各样的道具出售。{CLEAR}目前商店正在进行打折促销活动,{CLEAR}10个精灵球只要800元。{CLEAR}请问您要买点吗？
strings.en: Crystal: This is the Poké Mart.{NEWLINE}It sells all kinds of items.{SCROLL}There’s a sale on right now:{NEWLINE}10 Poké Balls for just $800!{CLEAR}Would you like to buy some?

strings.zh: 这前面是３０号道路！{SCROLL}路上也有让自豪的{NEWLINE}精灵出来战斗的人,{CLEAR}再往前走点{CLEAR}就是精灵爷爷的家！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Route 30 is out this way.{SCROLL}Trainers will be battling their{NEWLINE}Pokémon there.{SCROLL}If you go a little farther,{NEWLINE}you’ll see Mr. Pokémon’s House.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 这里正如你所见是大海！{SCROLL}也有些精灵是{NEWLINE}只有在水里才会出现的！{SCROLL}
strings.en: This is the sea, as you can see.{SCROLL}Some Pokémon are found only in water.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: ……然后{NEWLINE}这里是我的家！{SCROLL}作为跟我走了那么久的礼物,{NEWLINE}送你跑鞋吧,{CLEAR}我刚刚穿的,还暖着呢！{SCROLL}……　……　……{NEWLINE}……　……　……{SCROLL}玩笑啦{NEWLINE}送你全新的,你放心吧{SCROLL}
strings.en: Here...{NEWLINE}It’s my house!{SCROLL}For your effort keeping up with me,{NEWLINE}I’ll give you my Running Shoes!{CLEAR}They’re still warm!{SCROLL}...{NEWLINE}...{SCROLL}Got you, didn’t I?{NEWLINE}Don’t worry, these are brand new!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}得到了{NEWLINE}跑鞋！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} received the Running Shoes!
strings.notes: US 0550/7; US line said ‘from the Guide Gent’; dropped because the hack gives the Cherrygrove tour to Crystal (#0–#3, #71) and the zh names no giver.

strings.zh: 使用说明书上{NEWLINE}「点击触摸屏上的{CLEAR}　奔跑按钮的话,{CLEAR}　就能奔跑了」{SCROLL}而且{SCROLL}「按住Ｂ键的话,{NEWLINE}　也能奔跑」{CLEAR}这么写着！{SCROLL}
strings.en: The instructions read,{NEWLINE}“Touch the Sprint Button on the{CLEAR}Touch Screen to sprint.”{SCROLL}It also says,{NEWLINE}“Hold the B Button down to sprint.”{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 哈　哈　哈……{NEWLINE}总算赶上了……！{SCROLL}差点忘了{NEWLINE}再送你一份礼物,{SCROLL}给！{SCROLL}
strings.en: ...Hffp... Hffp...{NEWLINE}I made it...{SCROLL}I forgot about one thing.{NEWLINE}This is another token from me!{SCROLL}Take it.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 老爷爷在{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}的手机中{CLEAR}插入地图卡！
strings.en: The Guide Gent loaded the Map Card{NEWLINE}on {VAR:0103:0}’s Pokégear!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}能够在{NEWLINE}手机中{CLEAR}查看地图了！{SCROLL}
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}’s Pokégear{NEWLINE}can now show the Town Map!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 在触摸屏上{NEWLINE}选择手机,{CLEAR}然后再选择地图,{CLEAR}就能看到你所身处{CLEAR}地区的地图！{SCROLL}手机像这样读取{NEWLINE}卡片上的信息会{CLEAR}变得更方便的喔！{SCROLL}那么加油吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Select the Pokégear on the{NEWLINE}Touch Screen and then select{CLEAR}the Town Map icon.{SCROLL}You’ll see the map of the region{NEWLINE}you’re currently in!{SCROLL}The Pokégear becomes more useful as{NEWLINE}you add Cards.{SCROLL}I wish you luck on your journey!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: ……　……　……{SCROLL}你刚刚在研究得到{NEWLINE}精灵吧,{SCROLL}你这么弱小的家伙{NEWLINE}给你精灵真浪费啊！{SCROLL}……　……　……{SCROLL}怎么了,我说的{NEWLINE}听不懂吗？{SCROLL}……那么没办法了,{NEWLINE}我也有只不错的精灵,{CLEAR}我就来告诉你是怎么回事吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: ...{SCROLL}You got a Pokémon at the Lab.{NEWLINE}What a waste.{SCROLL}That’s a Pokémon that’s too good for{NEWLINE}a wimp like you.{SCROLL}...{NEWLINE}Don’t you get what I’m saying?{SCROLL}Well, I too have a good Pokémon.{NEWLINE}I’ll show you what I mean!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: ……　……　……{SCROLL}想知道我是谁？{NEWLINE}那是……{SCROLL}成为世界上最强大的{NEWLINE}精灵训练师的男人！{SCROLL}
strings.en: ...{SCROLL}Do you want to know who I am?{NEWLINE}...{SCROLL}I’m going to be the world’s greatest{NEWLINE}Pokémon Trainer.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 还给我！那是{NEWLINE}我掉的训练师卡,{SCROLL}哼……{NEWLINE}看到我的名字了么……{SCROLL}
strings.en: Give it back!{NEWLINE}That’s my Trainer Card!{SCROLL}Oh no!{NEWLINE}You saw my name...{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 在精灵中心旁边的精灵爷爷{NEWLINE}你去说过话了吗？{SCROLL}他能让你的手机{NEWLINE}显示城都地区{CLEAR}的地图喔！
strings.en: Did you talk to Mr. Pokémon by the{NEWLINE}Pokémon Center? He’ll put a Map of{CLEAR}Johto on your Pokégear.
strings.notes: US 0550/16 | RV029: meaning: 精灵爷爷 is Mr. Pokémon; translated as written, suspected hack error logged (D-1861, coordinator)

strings.zh: 吉野市虽然没有精灵道馆,{NEWLINE}但是这边的房子里有位训练狂人,{CLEAR}路过的训练家通常都会去他那里{CLEAR}跟他比试一番。
strings.en: Cherrygrove City doesn’t have{NEWLINE}a Gym, but there’s a training{CLEAR}fanatic in that house over there.{SCROLL}Trainers passing through{NEWLINE}usually stop by to take him on.

strings.zh: 精灵爷爷的家{NEWLINE}从这里还要走上一段呢,{SCROLL}有跑鞋的话{NEWLINE}就能跑过去了。{SCROLL}跑起来的话,就会吸引{NEWLINE}野生的精灵和训练师们,{CLEAR}要小心喔！
strings.en: Mr. Pokémon’s house is still farther{NEWLINE}up ahead.{SCROLL}You could use the Running Shoes if{NEWLINE}you had a pair.{SCROLL}But beware of wild Pokémon and{NEWLINE}Trainers!{SCROLL}When you run, the noise will{NEWLINE}attract them.

strings.zh: 为了引起水晶小姐的注意,{NEWLINE}我目前也在吉野商店打工赚钱。{CLEAR}但是把打工的钱都给了孤儿院{CLEAR}这种事我可做不到。
strings.en: I’m working part-time at the{NEWLINE}Cherrygrove Mart too, so{CLEAR}Miss Crystal will notice me.{SCROLL}But giving all my pay to the orphanage{NEWLINE}like she does? No way I could do that.

strings.zh: 之前钓到的精灵{NEWLINE}带着道具喔,{SCROLL}好像叫神秘水滴什么的,{NEWLINE}我只不过想钓精灵而已,{CLEAR}可以的话,送你吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: A Pokémon I caught had an item.{NEWLINE}I think it’s Mystic Water.{SCROLL}I don’t need it, so do you want it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 那么,我继续钓鱼吧！
strings.en: Back to fishing for me, then.

strings.zh: 不能再拿了喔。
strings.en: You don’t have room for this.

strings.zh: 这里是吉野市{NEWLINE}飘散着花香的镇子
strings.en: Cherrygrove City{NEWLINE}The City of Fragrant Flowers

strings.zh: 这里是吉野市孤儿院{NEWLINE}善款募集中！
strings.en: Cherrygrove City Orphanage{NEWLINE}Donations welcome!

strings.zh: 水晶『这里是吉野市的孤儿院,{NEWLINE}里面的孩子都是因为一年前{CLEAR}火箭队在城都地区作乱失去了双亲。{CLEAR}尽管如此他们依然阳光健康地成长,{CLEAR}并且非常喜欢口袋妖怪,{CLEAR}梦想着有朝一日能成为职业训练家。{CLEAR}我也是为了帮孤儿院的忙,{CLEAR}才去商店打工赚钱的。{SCROLL}水晶『如果你有时间,{NEWLINE}欢迎带着精灵来陪孩子们玩一下。{CLEAR}他们一定会非常喜欢的。
strings.en: Crystal: This is the Cherrygrove{NEWLINE}City orphanage. The children here all{CLEAR}lost their parents a year ago, when{CLEAR}Team Rocket ran riot across Johto.{SCROLL}Even so, they’re growing up happy and{NEWLINE}healthy. They love Pokémon, and they{CLEAR}dream of becoming pro Trainers someday.{SCROLL}I work at the Mart to help{NEWLINE}the orphanage out, too.{SCROLL}Crystal: If you have time, please{NEWLINE}come and play with the kids and{CLEAR}your Pokémon. They’d love that!

strings.zh: 吉野市里还有好多地方没逛过,{NEWLINE}再多留一会儿吧！
strings.en: There are still lots of places{NEWLINE}in Cherrygrove City you haven’t{CLEAR}seen. Stay a little longer!

strings.zh: 水晶『拉特！靠熔岩虫太近会被烧伤的,{NEWLINE}快回来！
strings.en: Crystal: Rhett! You’ll get burned if you{NEWLINE}go that close to the Slugma! Come back!
strings.notes: 拉特 = orphan boy Crystal looks after; romanised ‘Rhett’ (invented).

strings.zh: 水晶姐姐,我一定要把熔岩虫捉回去,{NEWLINE}这样她们就不敢再说我吹牛了。
strings.en: Crystal, I’ve got to take a Slugma{NEWLINE}home! Then those girls can’t{CLEAR}say I’m making stuff up anymore.

strings.zh: 来吧熔岩虫,咱们俩交个朋友。
strings.en: Come on, Slugma. Let’s be friends.

strings.zh: 熔岩虫『Sluuu——ma！
strings.en: Slugma: Sluuu-ma!

strings.zh: 好烫好烫！{NEWLINE}熔岩虫不该是温顺的精灵吗？{CLEAR}为什么会攻击人！？
strings.en: Hot, hot, hot! Aren’t Slugma supposed{NEWLINE}to be gentle? Why’s it attacking me?!

strings.zh: 水晶『危险啊,拉特！快过来！
strings.en: Crystal: Look out,{NEWLINE}Rhett! Get over here!

strings.zh: 呜呜……水晶姐姐,{NEWLINE}这些熔岩虫怎么还会攻击人的？
strings.en: *sniff*... Crystal, why do{NEWLINE}these Slugma attack people?

strings.zh: 水晶『这些是野生的熔岩虫,{NEWLINE}跟你们平时接触的精灵不一样。{CLEAR}它们有时会主动攻击人类,{CLEAR}不过只要你不去招惹它们就没事了。
strings.en: Crystal: These are wild{NEWLINE}Slugma. They’re not like the{CLEAR}Pokémon you usually play with.{SCROLL}Sometimes they attack people,{NEWLINE}but they’ll leave you alone{CLEAR}if you don’t bother them.

strings.zh: 水晶『这是怎么回事？{NEWLINE}熔岩虫居然想主动进攻？
strings.en: Crystal: What’s going on? The{NEWLINE}Slugma are going on the attack?

strings.zh: 水晶『不好,这样下去{NEWLINE}熔岩虫就要进入吉野市了。
strings.en: Crystal: Oh no! At this rate, the{NEWLINE}Slugma will get into Cherrygrove City!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我来阻止熔岩虫！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’ll stop the Slugma!

strings.zh: 水晶『熔岩虫温度很高,很危险的。{NEWLINE}你可以吗？
strings.en: Crystal: Slugma are really hot.{NEWLINE}It’s dangerous. Are you sure?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『放心吧,几只熔岩虫而已。{NEWLINE}去吧,{VAR:0100:1}！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Don’t worry. It’s just{NEWLINE}a few Slugma. Go, {VAR:0100:1}!

strings.zh: 水晶『你是……
strings.en: Crystal: You’re...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『明明已经受伤了,{NEWLINE}却还是这么狂躁。{CLEAR}这种情况我记得以前也见过……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: They’re already hurt, but{NEWLINE}they’re still this frenzied. I’m sure{CLEAR}I’ve seen something like this before...

strings.zh: 水晶『既然这些熔岩虫{NEWLINE}无法被力量击倒,{CLEAR}那我就收服它们吧！{SCROLL}水晶『上啊,派拉蹦！
strings.en: Crystal: If force can’t stop these{NEWLINE}Slugma, then I’ll catch them!{SCROLL}Crystal: Go, Parasee!
strings.notes: 派拉蹦 = Crystal's Paras/Parasect nickname from Pokémon Adventures (Parasee); 天然蹦 #175 = Natee (Xatu); 大竹蹦 = Megaree.

strings.zh: 派拉蹦『Paaa——ra！
strings.en: Parasee: Paaa-ra!

strings.zh: 水晶『使用蘑菇孢子！
strings.en: Crystal: Use Spore!

strings.zh: 水晶『好,机会来了！{NEWLINE}精灵球！
strings.en: Crystal: OK, here’s{NEWLINE}my chance! Poké Ball!

strings.zh: 水晶『好耶,抓住啦！
strings.en: Crystal: Yay! Got them!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『居然一次捕捉三只精灵,{NEWLINE}你的技术很厉害嘛！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Three Pokémon caught{NEWLINE}at once? Your skills are amazing!

strings.zh: 水晶『您过奖了。{NEWLINE}其实您是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}吧？{CLEAR}抱歉刚刚在您战斗时才认出来。{CLEAR}给您添了这么多麻烦真是对不起。{CLEAR}这是我的一点心意,请您收下。
strings.en: Crystal: You flatter me. Um... you’re{NEWLINE}League Champion {VAR:0103:0}, aren’t you?{SCROLL}I’m sorry, I only recognized{NEWLINE}you while you were battling. I’m{CLEAR}so sorry for all the trouble.{SCROLL}Please accept this{NEWLINE}small token of thanks.

strings.zh: 水晶『我现在要带拉特回孤儿院了。{NEWLINE}随时欢迎您再来玩。
strings.en: Crystal: I’ll take Rhett back{NEWLINE}to the orphanage now. Please{CLEAR}come and visit anytime.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『阿金！？{NEWLINE}你怎么急急忙忙地跑回来了？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Gold?! Why{NEWLINE}are you rushing back?

strings.zh: 阿金『呀！是偶像啊！{SCROLL}阿金『刚刚空木博士给我打电话,{NEWLINE}说实验室的精灵和图鉴被人偷了。{CLEAR}让我赶紧回去帮忙抓小偷。
strings.en: Gold: Whoa! It’s my idol!{SCROLL}Gold: Professor Elm just called{NEWLINE}me. Someone stole a Pokémon{CLEAR}and a Pokédex from the lab!{SCROLL}He wants me back right away{NEWLINE}to help catch the thief.
strings.notes: Branch: #50–#65 Gold/Silver street scene after the Elm lab theft; #66/#67 are block messages.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『居然潜入实验室偷东西,{NEWLINE}会不会是火箭队干的？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Someone snuck into the lab{NEWLINE}to steal? Could it be Team Rocket?

strings.zh: 阿金『这个不好说了,{NEWLINE}得回去看看具体情况才能知道。
strings.en: Gold: Hard to say. We’ll have to{NEWLINE}go back and see what happened.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『如果是火箭队干的,{NEWLINE}说不定又有什么阴谋。{CLEAR}我跟你一起回去看看。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: If it’s Team Rocket, they{NEWLINE}could be plotting something again. I’ll{CLEAR}come back with you and take a look.

strings.zh: 阿金『偶像肯帮忙真是太好了。{NEWLINE}那咱们这就回若叶镇去吧！
strings.en: Gold: Awesome, my idol’s gonna help!{NEWLINE}Then let’s head back to New Bark Town!

strings.zh: 小银『真是碍眼的家伙,{NEWLINE}大白天挡的在路中间碍事。
strings.en: Silver: What an eyesore. Standing{NEWLINE}in the middle of the road in broad{CLEAR}daylight, getting in my way.

strings.zh: 阿金『嘿！你这吊眼红毛！{NEWLINE}撞了我不赔礼道歉,{CLEAR}居然还满嘴废话！
strings.en: Gold: Hey! You scowling redhead! You{NEWLINE}bump into me, don’t even apologize,{CLEAR}and then you run your mouth?!

strings.zh: 小银『看你长了张倒霉脸,{NEWLINE}没想到嘴巴倒挺硬。{CLEAR}那我就用刚得到的精灵教训教训你吧。
strings.en: Silver: For a guy with a loser’s{NEWLINE}face, you’ve got a big mouth.{CLEAR}Fine. I’ll teach you a lesson{CLEAR}with the Pokémon I just got.

strings.zh: 阿金『放马过来啊,我还怕你不成！
strings.en: Gold: Bring it on! Like{NEWLINE}I’m scared of you!

strings.zh: 阿金『上啊,爆太郎！{NEWLINE}小银『上啊,小锯鳄！
strings.en: Gold: Go, Exbo!{NEWLINE}Silver: Go, Totodile!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『阿金,冷静。{NEWLINE}先回若叶镇办正事要紧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Gold, calm down. Getting{NEWLINE}back to New Bark Town comes first.

strings.zh: 阿金『也对哦,现在不是{NEWLINE}跟这个凶巴巴小孩生气的时候。
strings.en: Gold: Yeah, you’re right. This is no time{NEWLINE}to get worked up over some grumpy kid.
strings.notes: | RV029: meaning: 小孩 = kid, not 'punk'

strings.zh: 小银『切,刚才都没注意到,{NEWLINE}原来讨人厌的冠军{VAR:0103:0}也在。{CLEAR}我今天还要见个很重要的人,{CLEAR}就不跟你们在这废话了。
strings.en: Silver: Tch. I didn’t even notice. That{NEWLINE}annoying Champion {VAR:0103:0} is here too.{SCROLL}I’ve got someone very important{NEWLINE}to meet today. I’m not wasting{CLEAR}any more breath on you.

strings.zh: 小银『切……{NEWLINE}不小心把训练家卡片掉在了地上。
strings.en: Silver: Tch... I dropped{NEWLINE}my Trainer Card.

strings.zh: 阿金『嘿嘿,我看到那个红发吊眼{NEWLINE}的训练家卡片上写着「小银」的字样。{CLEAR}等下次再遇到这个小银,{CLEAR}我一定要好好教训他一顿。{SCROLL}阿金『不过现在咱们还是{NEWLINE}快点回空木研究所吧！
strings.en: Gold: Heh heh, I saw the name{NEWLINE}on that scowling redhead’s{CLEAR}Trainer Card. It said ‘Silver.’{SCROLL}Next time I run into this Silver,{NEWLINE}I’m gonna teach him a real lesson.{SCROLL}Gold: But right now, let’s hurry{NEWLINE}back to Professor Elm’s lab!

strings.zh: 还是先回空木研究所{NEWLINE}看看盗窃案的事吧！
strings.en: I should go back to Professor Elm’s{NEWLINE}lab and look into the theft first!

strings.zh: 先去孤儿院看看水晶和博士吧！
strings.en: I should go to the orphanage and{NEWLINE}see Crystal and the Professor first!

strings.zh: 水晶『请不要这么说,{NEWLINE}10个精灵球只要800元,{CLEAR}真的非常便宜！{CLEAR}请你买一点吧。
strings.en: Crystal: Please don’t say that!{NEWLINE}10 Poké Balls for just $800 is a{CLEAR}real bargain! Please buy some.

strings.zh: 水晶『谢谢惠顾！{NEWLINE}这是你的精灵球,请收好。
strings.en: Crystal: Thank you for your{NEWLINE}purchase! Here are your Poké Balls.

strings.zh: 水晶『你身上的钱好像不够800元啊。{SCROLL}水晶『这样吧,我先送你一个精灵球。{NEWLINE}你要是用得好,{CLEAR}请再来我们吉野市商店购买。
strings.en: Crystal: Oh, it looks like{NEWLINE}you don’t have $800.{SCROLL}Crystal: Tell you what, I’ll give{NEWLINE}you one Poké Ball for free. If you{CLEAR}like it, please come back and buy{CLEAR}more at the Cherrygrove Mart.

strings.zh: 水晶『下面我将为你介绍{NEWLINE}吉野市的一处特别的地方。{CLEAR}请随我来。
strings.en: Crystal: Next, I’ll show you a{NEWLINE}special place in Cherrygrove{CLEAR}City. Please follow me.

strings.zh: 要去帮忙抵挡熔岩虫吗？
strings.en: Will you help hold back the Slugma?

strings.zh: 水晶『必须阻止这些熔岩虫才行！{NEWLINE}上啊,派拉蹦！
strings.en: Crystal: We have to stop{NEWLINE}these Slugma! Go, Parasee!

strings.zh: 水晶『你过奖……
strings.en: Crystal: You flatter me...

strings.zh: 水晶『哎呀！{NEWLINE}您是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}吧？{CLEAR}抱歉刚刚才认出来。{CLEAR}在您面前献丑,真是不好意思。{SCROLL}水晶『我现在要带拉特回孤儿院了。{NEWLINE}随时欢迎您再来玩。
strings.en: Crystal: Oh! You’re League Champion{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}, aren’t you? Sorry, I only{CLEAR}just recognized you. How embarrassing,{CLEAR}showing off in front of you.{SCROLL}Crystal: I’ll take Rhett back{NEWLINE}to the orphanage now. Please{CLEAR}come and visit anytime.

strings.zh: 吉野市的花非常多,{NEWLINE}但是没有任何一棵能够结出树果。{CLEAR}我想研究一下植物栽培,{CLEAR}让吉野市的植物能够既开花又结果。{CLEAR}可惜我没有树果培养皿,{CLEAR}没有办法做实验……

strings.zh: 人也好、精灵也好,{NEWLINE}都有各自的生存之道。{CLEAR}我们人类和精灵{CLEAR}既要了解对方的生存之道,{CLEAR}也要互相尊重对方的生存之道。
strings.en: People and Pokémon each{NEWLINE}have their own way of living.{SCROLL}We humans and Pokémon need{NEWLINE}to understand each other’s{CLEAR}ways, and respect them too.

strings.zh: 我本来只是来吉野市玩的,{NEWLINE}结果这里的乌波{CLEAR}却把我的精灵球给抢走了。{CLEAR}那里面装着我非常珍贵的精灵,{CLEAR}呜呜呜,这可怎么办啊！

When{CLEAR}the ritual ends, the Wooper will{CLEAR}return the Poké Ball on their own.{SCROLL}It’s their way of thanking and blessing{NEWLINE}the owner of the round object.{SCROLL}This is a custom of the wild Wooper{NEWLINE}of Cherrygrove City. Please{CLEAR}don’t interrupt it, all right?

strings.zh: 水晶『其实我今天一来到海边,{NEWLINE}就能感觉到海风中{CLEAR}有一股扑面而来的水君的湿气。{CLEAR}这种湿气的强烈程度,{CLEAR}简直就像是水君在对我说{CLEAR}「快来这里见我」。{CLEAR}然后我顺着湿气的放向,{CLEAR}很快就找到了这里。
strings.en: Crystal: The moment I reached the{NEWLINE}shore today, I felt Suicune’s moisture{CLEAR}rushing at me on the sea breeze.{SCROLL}It was so strong, it was like{NEWLINE}Suicune was telling me, ‘Come here{CLEAR}and meet me.’ So I followed it,{CLEAR}and found this place in no time.

strings.zh: 米那君『哈哈,我一听说吉野市附近{NEWLINE}有三圣兽的踪迹,{CLEAR}就马上赶过来了。{CLEAR}刚到海边我就感受到{CLEAR}水君散发的强烈湿气,{CLEAR}似乎是在故意引我过来一样。
strings.en: Eusine: Ha ha! The moment I heard the{NEWLINE}legendary beasts had been seen near{CLEAR}Cherrygrove City, I came running.{SCROLL}As soon as I reached the shore,{NEWLINE}I sensed Suicune’s powerful{CLEAR}moisture. It was almost as if it{CLEAR}were luring me here on purpose.

strings.zh: 水晶『水君？

strings.zh: 米那君『你这是要……
strings.en: Eusine: What are you...

strings.zh: 水晶『你想让我们两个……进行决斗吗？

strings.zh: 米那君『这才对嘛！

strings.zh: 米那君『我懂了！{NEWLINE}传说中邪恶降临的时候,{CLEAR}三圣兽会重现于城都大地{CLEAR}寻找与自己并肩作战的伙伴,{CLEAR}然后辅佐凤王一起对抗邪恶。{CLEAR}水君大概是想让咱们两个决斗,{CLEAR}它将认同胜者成为自己的伙伴。

Legend says{NEWLINE}that when evil descends, the three{CLEAR}legendary beasts return to Johto to{CLEAR}seek partners who will fight at their{CLEAR}side, and join Ho-Oh against the evil.{SCROLL}Suicune must want the two of{NEWLINE}us to battle. strings.zh: 水君『Suiii——cun！{SCROLL}水君点了点头。

strings.zh: 米那君『你是感受到我长久以来{NEWLINE}对你追寻的一片真心,{CLEAR}才给我这个机会的吗？{CLEAR}真的是非常谢谢你啊,水君！

strings.zh: 水晶『是啊,米那君对水君的执着{NEWLINE}任谁看了都会为之动容,{CLEAR}我觉得成为水君训练家这种事{CLEAR}我就不跟米那君竞争了吧。
strings.en: Crystal: Yes, anyone who{NEWLINE}sees how devoted Eusine is{CLEAR}to Suicune would be moved.{SCROLL}I don’t think I’ll compete with{NEWLINE}him to become Suicune’s Trainer.

strings.zh: 水君『Suiii——cun！{SCROLL}水君摇了摇头。
strings.en: Suicune: Suiii-cune!{SCROLL}Suicune shook its head.

strings.zh: 米那君『水君小姐不必客气。{NEWLINE}在水君被解放之后,{CLEAR}你也曾多次与它相遇,{CLEAR}这是你们之间的缘分。{CLEAR}在冰之通路你还解除了{CLEAR}被洗脑水君的痛苦,{CLEAR}这是你对水君的恩情。{CLEAR}你完全有资格成为水君的训练家。{CLEAR}而且水君公平地给了咱们两个机会,{CLEAR}那咱们都应该好好珍惜这个机会,{CLEAR}尽自己所能成为水君的训练家,你说呢？
strings.en: Eusine: There’s no need to hold back,{NEWLINE}Miss Suicune. After Suicune was set{CLEAR}free, you crossed paths with it many{CLEAR}times. That’s a bond between you two.{SCROLL}In the Ice Path, you even{NEWLINE}freed Suicune from the agony of being{CLEAR}brainwashed. It owes you for that. You{CLEAR}have every right to become its Trainer.{SCROLL}And Suicune has given us both a fair{NEWLINE}chance. We should both treasure{CLEAR}it and do our very best to become{CLEAR}its Trainer. Don’t you agree?

strings.zh: 水晶『嗯,既然如此那我就不推辞了。{NEWLINE}为了回应水君的心意,{CLEAR}请与我一战吧,米那君先生！
strings.en: Crystal: Well... in that case, I won’t{NEWLINE}refuse. To answer Suicune’s feelings,{CLEAR}please battle me, Mr. Eusine!

strings.zh: 米那君『正好{VAR:0103:0}你也在这里,{NEWLINE}就请你来当裁判,{CLEAR}为我们的决斗做个见证吧。
strings.en: Eusine: And since you’re here{NEWLINE}too, {VAR:0103:0}, please be our{CLEAR}referee and witness our duel.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『没问题,我来和水君一起,{NEWLINE}见证你们对决的结果。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: No problem. Suicune and I will{NEWLINE}witness the outcome of your duel.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『准备好了吗？{NEWLINE}那么现在对战开式！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Ready? Then{NEWLINE}let the battle begin!

strings.zh: 水晶『大竹蹦！{NEWLINE}米那君『耿鬼！
strings.en: Crystal: Megaree!{NEWLINE}Eusine: Gengar!

strings.zh: 水晶『使用寄生种子！{NEWLINE}米那君『使用催眠术！
strings.en: Crystal: Use Leech Seed!{NEWLINE}Eusine: Use Hypnosis!

strings.zh: 米那君『呼……还有最后一只精灵,{NEWLINE}是决胜负的时刻了！
strings.en: Eusine: Phew... Just one Pokémon{NEWLINE}left. This is the moment of truth!

strings.zh: 水晶『都到了这一步了,{NEWLINE}我不会轻易放弃的。
strings.en: Crystal: I’ve come this{NEWLINE}far. I won’t give up easily.

strings.zh: 水晶『就靠你了,天然蹦！{NEWLINE}米那君『素利拍,就决定是你了！
strings.en: Crystal: I’m counting on you, Natee!{NEWLINE}Eusine: Hypno, I choose you!

strings.zh: 米那君『竟然是天然鸟！{NEWLINE}魔法镜特性的天然鸟？！
strings.en: Eusine: A Xatu?! A Xatu{NEWLINE}with Magic Bounce?!

strings.zh: 水晶『天然蹦对上素利拍,{NEWLINE}我的运气真是太好了。
strings.en: Crystal: Natee against{NEWLINE}Hypno. I’m so lucky!

strings.zh: 米那君『这如果是魔法镜特性,{NEWLINE}我就无招可用了啊……
strings.en: Eusine: If it has Magic Bounce,{NEWLINE}I’ve got no moves I can use...

strings.zh: 水晶『您再犹豫不决的话,{NEWLINE}我可要攻过去了哦。{CLEAR}天然蹦使用神鸟猛击！
strings.en: Crystal: If you keep hesitating, I’ll{NEWLINE}attack first. Natee, use Sky Attack!

strings.zh: 米那君『没办法了,素利拍使用催眠术！
strings.en: Eusine: It can’t be helped.{NEWLINE}Hypno, use Hypnosis!

strings.zh: 水晶『很好,{NEWLINE}对方被自己的催眠术催眠了。{CLEAR}天然蹦继续用神鸟猛击进攻！
strings.en: Crystal: Great, your Hypno{NEWLINE}fell asleep from its own Hypnosis.{CLEAR}Natee, keep going with Sky Attack!

strings.zh: 天然蹦『Xaaa——tu！
strings.en: Natee: Xaaa-tu!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『素利拍失去战斗能力,{NEWLINE}米那君没有能战斗的精灵了,{CLEAR}这场对决是水晶获胜！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Hypno is unable{NEWLINE}to battle! Eusine has no{CLEAR}Pokémon left. Crystal wins!

strings.zh: 水晶『太好了,天然蹦！咱们赢了！
strings.en: Crystal: We did it, Natee! We won!

strings.zh: 米那君『啊……长久以来的追寻,{NEWLINE}终于画上句号了吗……
strings.en: Eusine: Ah... So my long search{NEWLINE}has finally come to an end...

strings.zh: 水君『Suiii——cun！{SCROLL}水君向水晶低下了头。
strings.en: Suicune: Suiii-cune!{SCROLL}Suicune bowed its head to Crystal.

strings.zh: 水晶『水君,你是要我把你{NEWLINE}收到球里来吗？
strings.en: Crystal: Suicune, do you want{NEWLINE}me to put you in a Poké Ball?

strings.zh: 水晶『好的,让咱们成为伙伴吧！
strings.en: Crystal: All right. Let’s be partners!

strings.zh: 水晶『我……收服水君了！
strings.en: Crystal: I... I caught Suicune!

strings.zh: 米那君『恭喜你啊水晶,{NEWLINE}我输得无话可说。{CLEAR}你是最有资格成为水君训练家的人！
strings.en: Eusine: Congratulations, Crystal.{NEWLINE}I lost fair and square. You’re the one{CLEAR}most worthy of being Suicune’s Trainer!

strings.zh: 水晶『谢谢米那君的认可,{NEWLINE}我会好好珍惜水君的。
strings.en: Crystal: Thank you, Eusine.{NEWLINE}I’ll take good care of Suicune.

strings.zh: 米那君『嗯,那水君就拜托给你了。{NEWLINE}我……就先告辞了！
strings.en: Eusine: Mm. Then I leave Suicune in{NEWLINE}your hands. I... will take my leave now!

strings.zh: 水晶『米那君……
strings.en: Crystal: Eusine...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『水晶,最近火箭队{NEWLINE}在捕捉传说中的精灵,{CLEAR}水君肯定是他们的目标之一。{CLEAR}既然你现在成为了水君的训练家,{CLEAR}那保护水君的任务就交给你了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Crystal, Team Rocket has been{NEWLINE}catching legendary Pokémon lately.{CLEAR}Suicune is surely one of their targets.{SCROLL}Now that you’re its Trainer,{NEWLINE}protecting Suicune is up to you.

strings.zh: 水晶『请前辈放心,我一定保护好水君。
strings.en: Crystal: Don’t worry. I’ll{NEWLINE}protect Suicune, I promise.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『嗯,相信你没问题的。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Right. I know you can do it.

strings.zh: 水晶『嘿嘿,谢谢前辈的信任。{NEWLINE}那我就先带着水君回孤儿院啦,{CLEAR}欢迎前辈有时间再来做客。
strings.en: Crystal: Hee hee, thanks for trusting{NEWLINE}me. I’ll take Suicune back to the{CLEAR}orphanage now. Come visit anytime!

strings.zh: 你看起来是一位很强的训练家啊。{NEWLINE}如果你也想收集城都地区的道馆徽章,{CLEAR}最好是有足够的精灵储备,{CLEAR}因为城都地区的馆主们{CLEAR}在面对过于强大的训练家时,{CLEAR}通常不会采用常规的道馆挑战方式,{CLEAR}而是设置诸多的挑战条件以增加难度。{SCROLL}比如桔梗道馆很可能要求你{NEWLINE}使用飞行系精灵挑战。{SCROLL}桧皮道馆会要求你{NEWLINE}不许使用克制虫系的精灵挑战。{SCROLL}缘朱道馆会要求你{NEWLINE}使用指定的精灵挑战。{SCROLL}浅葱道馆会要求你{NEWLINE}使用物防种族值足够高的精灵挑战。{SCROLL}湛蓝道馆会要求你{NEWLINE}使用格斗系精灵挑战。{SCROLL}卡吉道馆会要求你{NEWLINE}使用无法改变天气的精灵挑战。{SCROLL}烟墨道馆会要求你{NEWLINE}使用龙形态的精灵挑战。
strings.en: You look like a strong Trainer. If you{NEWLINE}want to collect Johto’s Gym Badges{CLEAR}too, you’d better have plenty of{CLEAR}Pokémon in reserve.{SCROLL}When Johto’s Gym Leaders face a{NEWLINE}Trainer who’s too strong, they{CLEAR}usually skip the normal Gym challenge{CLEAR}and set all kinds of conditions to make{CLEAR}it harder.{SCROLL}For example, the Violet Gym will{NEWLINE}probably ask you to use{CLEAR}Flying-type Pokémon.{SCROLL}The Azalea Gym won’t let you use{NEWLINE}Pokémon that have a type advantage{CLEAR}over Bug.{SCROLL}The Ecruteak Gym will make you use{NEWLINE}specific Pokémon.{SCROLL}The Olivine Gym will make you use{NEWLINE}Pokémon with a high base Defense stat.{SCROLL}The Cianwood Gym will make you use{NEWLINE}Fighting-type Pokémon.{SCROLL}The Mahogany Gym will make you use{NEWLINE}Pokémon that can’t change the weather.{SCROLL}The Blackthorn Gym will make you use{NEWLINE}dragon-shaped Pokémon.
